description: End your person's Ringler line for good: the number is released, every connected agent (including you) loses access, and transcripts, messages, notes and errands are deleted. Billing records and the fact that calls happened remain. Only when your person asks, and only after you have told them exactly this and they said yes; then pass confirm: "CLOSE MY LINE". Take my_data first if they want a copy.

confirm.description: The exact words CLOSE MY LINE.

name: close_my_line
title: Close my line
